fact: The SeyID ID-Wallet page says the Digital Driving License, issued with the Seychelles Licensing Authority, requires a SeyID and a licence from the SLA and is connected to the SLA System.

Seychelles Nation reports the Agency for Social Protection's ASP Connect platform, launched internally on 15 October 2025, is accessible through the SeyID portal, which hosts all government entities' systems; the free text gives no detail of what SeyID checks.
At the SeyID launch on 1 November 2022 the platform was in its final phases of integration with eGovernment services and financial institutions, per the article citing Seychelles News Agency.

fact: The SeyID page says government e-services that require SeyID need a 60% validation level, which is reached by checking the holder's NIN card or passport video against the Civil Status System.

The Seychelles Licensing Authority, DICT and the Seychelles Police launched a pilot digital driving licence on 15 December 2023, which a citizen holding a SeyID and an SLA-issued licence activates in the SeyID app's ID-Wallet.

The Seychelles Licensing Authority says its business and vehicle licence online services moved to monServis and require a SeyID account, which needs a valid National Identity Number; the old E-ID Gateway no longer works (as_of is the page's published date).
The ICS says SEYID, introduced in 2022, lets users create a Digital Identity for accessing government services online.
